verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server is documented to "create and manage tasks and projects through natural language" and to generate reports. It gives example queries like "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week", and its interactive tools confirm changes inside Claude and ChatGPT. It also ships an Asana app in Claude and AI Teammates/agents that work inside workflows. missing for 10: clear documentation of a native in-product natural-language command interface (Asana Dash and AI Studio are only named, not described as NL command surfaces), independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works reliably.
